results.title: Engine information validates; uploads and SSE are claimed; Base 0.1 is offered
Responses echo MES-Version and carry MES-Request-Id, on success and on error
An unsupported MES-Version is refused with 400 unsupported_version
A request from a browser origin outside the allowlist is refused with 403 origin_not_allowed
Paired mode: the handshake needs no token; everything else answers 401 without one
Paired mode: the certificate served is the one tls.fingerprint_sha256 names
Descriptors validate, name their profile, and offer at least one licensed model
Adapter offers are consistent: an id names one adapter everywhere, defaults lie in their ranges
The operations list has an ETag, and If-None-Match answers 304
One descriptor by name matches the list; an unknown one is 404 unknown_operation
A job: 201 with Location, then held with a valid result, plan and provenance
Request errors: 400 invalid_request, 404 unknown_operation, 422 unsupported_parameter, with valid error bodies
An Idempotency-Key repeated returns the original job
A long poll on a held job answers at once with a valid snapshot
GET jobs lists the caller's jobs and filters by state
An output: its media type, its bytes and an ETag of its SHA-256
Outputs serve byte ranges: 206 with Content-Range, suffixes, and 416 beyond the end
Confirm purges: the job is purged and succeeded, its outputs answer 410 gone
Release is idempotent; a released job's outputs answer 410
Adapters: a run lists them in provenance with licence and strength; unknown, out-of-range and policy-failing ones are refused
Uploads: 201 with the right size and SHA-256, at most an hour's expiry, and single use
An upload whose Content-Digest doesn't match is refused
Grants: the engine pulls with the bearer token, and fails the job on a wrong SHA-256
SSE: framed events that validate, rising seq, output_ready, then job.ended after confirm
SSE resumes after Last-Event-ID
WebSocket: pong, engine.health on "*", the client's job events, error messages
Health validates
Retention deadlines respect the engine's TTLs

results.title: Outputs expire: after outputs_ttl_s the job is expired and its outputs answer 410
MCP: a session lists one tool per operation (dots → underscores) and the four helpers
Offers' declarations are consistent: Base supports keys typed, offer limits within the operation's
A gate the named model lacks is 422 unsupported_parameter; with no model named, the plan names an offer that has it
A voice implies its model: the plan lists it and provenance names it; an unlisted voice, or one the named model lacks, is 422
supports.seed false: a request with a seed runs, and warns seed_ignored
Voice lists: as many voices as supports.voices, with an ETag and 304; unique ids; a model without voices, or not offered, is 404
Users' acceptance: an offer whose licence has user_accept_required is 422 policy_unmet (terms_not_accepted) without policy.accepted, and runs with it
Assets: 201 with the right size and SHA-256 and an expiry within max_asset_ttl_s; listed; two jobs use it; DELETE, then 422 and 404
An asset whose Content-Digest doesn't match is refused, and one without ttl_s is 400

results.detail: asset expiry takes 60 s; run with --max-ttl-wait 75 or more

Paired mode, a second pairing: another client's asset isn't listed, can't be read, and is 422 in a job
Stream declarations: only on audio outputs with max 1; streaming is claimed exactly when some offer streams
A streamed job: plan.streams gives the format; chunks from 0 with no gaps, whole frames, one final, before output_ready; the output is the chunks
Release mid-stream: the outcome is cancelled, no final chunk is sent, and none follows the cancelled state
stream on an output that can't stream, or to a named model that doesn't stream, is 422 unsupported_parameter
After confirm, a replayed chunk carries no data

matte masks are 8-bit grey; extract carries alpha
